late_outcome_derivation: the owner relayed slate aggregates (primary 6-9, candidates 6-3, passes 0-6, P&L +$353.25, Brier 0.2568 vs 0.2491). The six late winner outcomes are the UNIQUE solution consistent with those aggregates given the frozen probabilities and registered prices (late candidates +$6.24 net is satisfiable only by PIT and SEA winning with LAA and CHC losing); every recomputed statistic then reproduces the relayed figures exactly. Per-game late SCORES are not relayed and are not displayed.
scope: all 15 MLB games final (owner-relayed aggregates); WNBA 2 final, WAS@PHX unrelayed
thesis: The active winner model and total model both lost to their expanding priors (winner Brier 0.2568 vs 0.2491; total MAE 4.77 vs 4.20). The strongest observed separation came from the price overlay: candidates finished 6-3 while every passed model side lost. However, five of six pass prices were reconstructed, so only the candidate performance and the WSH pass are supported by captured prices. One slate identifies a promising screening hypothesis — it does not establish a betting edge.
